subject: Invitation to Annual Company Dinner
body: Dear team, We are excited to invite you to our annual company dinner on Friday, December 10th at 7:00 PM. The event will be held at the Grand Ballroom in the Hilton Hotel. There will be a delicious dinner, live entertainment, and an opportunity to celebrate our achievements together. Please RSVP by November 30th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name]
